The calculation of 'net metric' values in the Task sheet resulted in inverted signs across multiple rows and columns.
The test_derived_values_and_stats in /tests/test_outputs.py failed with an AssertionError during assert_matrix. Specifically, the 'net metric' mismatches occurred in cells H35 through L40, where actual values had the opposite sign of the expected values (e.g., H35 expected -2.0476 but got 2.0476). While the workbook structure and lookup blocks passed, the formula logic for the net metric calculation is likely subtracting terms in the wrong order.
